summary: cloud.common will be removed from Ansible 12 because it doesn't work with ansible-core 2.19 and nothing in Ansible 12 needs it. It can still be installed with ansible-galaxy.
questions: Why is cloud.common being removed from the Ansible package?
How do I keep cloud.common after upgrading to Ansible 12?

answer_card.title: cloud.common removed from Ansible 12
answer_card.answer_md:
`cloud.common` is removed from Ansible 12. It doesn't work with ansible-core 2.19 and no included collection needs it. Install it yourself if needed:

```shell
ansible-galaxy collection install cloud.common
```
